# Distinctiveness = how rare is this combination of categorical values compared to overall distribution

combination_counts = df_copy['attribute_combination'].value_counts()
total_records = len(df_copy)

# Calculate distinctiveness score: lower frequency = higher distinctiveness
# We'll use inverse frequency: 1 / (frequency/total) = total/frequency

)
